description:
Application OLY 1 - Land bounded to the north by Eastway, the Lea Interchange, the A12, Ruckholt Road and Temple Mill Lane plus part of the recreation ground north of Temple Mills Bridge; bounded to the east by the overground railway, Central Line underground railway and the new Stratford Rail Land development, the London to Southend railway line and land on the eastern bank of the Waterworks River; bounded to the south by part of the Greenway, High Street Stratford (A11) to the Bow Interchange; and bounded to the west by the East Cross route (A12) and land on the western bank of the Hackney Cut of the River Lee Navigation.

Application OLY 1 - A mixed use comprehensive regeneration and redevelopment scheme initially to enable the Olympic and Paralympic Games to be held in the Lower Lea Valley in 2012 by the media/broadcast and other supporting facilities including parking; riverside concourse, open space and circulation areas; major infrastructure and services, including a combined heat an power energy centre, bridges and landbridges; site regarding, remediation, other enabling and engineering works including river and canal works, means of access, internal circulation, demolition, and miscellaneous ancillary and associated operations; together with the subsequent transformation of some of the facilities and land uses to provide The Post Olympic Legacy including construction of residential, business, industrial, retail, leisure and recreation, education and community facilities, places of worship, open space, means of access, parking, further river and canal engineering and associated operations.  The whole comprehensive redevelopment to be carried out in a co-ordinated programme in the following phases:
(PLANNING APPLICATION FROM THE JOINT PLANNING AUTHORITIES TEAM)

A.	Pre Olympic Construction Phase;
B.	The Olympic Games Phase;
C.	The Legacy Construction Phase; and
D.	The Post-Olympics Legacy Phase.
